text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can generate art, compose music, and even write stories or poems. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. AI, on the other hand, follows patterns it has learned and does not truly understand what it makes. Some people worry that AI will replace artists, but others believe it is simply a helpful tool. In the end, human creativity and AI can work together to produce exciting results.
